title: Conservation Policy Spending in Federal Legislation
description: Federally funded conservation restoration and resilience projects under two major US legislative acts: the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law (BIL) and the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA). Sourced from conservation.gov, the dataset covers over 2,100 project locations across the United States and territories. Available in cloud-optimized formats including GeoParquet, FlatGeobuf, and PMTiles.
